title: Mixed-Sector FJRW Correlators of a Three-Block Chain Sum and Textbook Formulation of the Frohman Problem

description: Formulation and complete selection-rule census (all_216_decoration_triples.csv, allowed_36.csv) for the mixed-sector Fan-Jarvis-Ruan-Witten (FJRW) correlators of the three-block chain potential F = W(x0,x3) + W(x1,x4) + W(x2,x5) with W = u^5 v + v^6 and symmetry group G_F = (Z/30Z)^3 of order 27,000, isolating the 36 selection-rule-allowed rooms and the 4 irreducible four-point mixed correlator seeds.
